check_service_status.description: Check whether the Avatar API is answering, how quickly, and how much of the rate limit is left. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it. Being throttled is reported separately from being down.

mock_response.message: The Avatar API is up and serving the show.

check_service_status.name: check_service_status

check_trivia_answer.description: Mark a player's answer to a question and get the right one back. The answer can be the option's letter or its words, however they are capitalised: 'Fire Nation' answers 'the Fire Nation'. A wrong answer, one that picks out none of the options and no answer at all are all marked wrong rather than failing the step, so a quiz bot can reply to anything a player sends.
check_trivia_answer.display_str_template: Check an answer to Avatar trivia question {0}.

mock_response.message: Correct: the answer is B) the Fire Nation.
mock_response.question: "Long ago, the four nations lived together in harmony. Then, everything changed when ________ attacked."

check_trivia_answer.name: check_trivia_answer

parameters.description: The question being answered: the question_id a trivia step returned. The same number always means the same question, with its options in the same order.
parameters.name: question_id

parameters.description: The player's answer: the option's letter (B) or its words (the Fire Nation), however they are capitalised or punctuated. A word or two is enough when only one option contains it: 'comet' answers Sozin's comet.
parameters.name: answer

get_character.description: Look up one character and get everything the service knows about them: their nation and bending, a portrait, nicknames, allies and enemies, titles, and who voiced them. Pick them from the list, or pass a name, a nickname or an id in from an earlier step: 'Mushi' finds Iroh, and a nickname two characters share comes back saying which rather than guessing. The service's records are a scrape of the Avatar Wiki with rows out of place; they are put back before anything is returned.
get_character.name: get_character

parameters.description: The character to look up. Pick one from the list, or type a name, a nickname (Mushi, Twinkle Toes, The Blue Spirit) or the character_id an earlier step returned. A partial name works when only one character matches it.

examples.label: An id from an earlier step

parameters.name: character

get_episode.description: Look up one episode: its title, season, air date, director, writers and animation studio. Pick it from the list, or pass a title, a code such as S02E06, or its number in the whole series (1 to 61) in from an earlier step. A title that fits several episodes - 'Sozin's Comet' has four parts - comes back listing them rather than guessing.
get_episode.name: get_episode

parameters.description: The episode to look up. Pick one from the list, or type a title, a code such as S02E06 or 2x06, or its number in the whole series, from 1 to 61. A partial title works when only one episode matches it.
parameters.name: episode

get_show_info.description: Get the show's synopsis, genres and creators, when it aired, and how many seasons and episodes it ran to, season by season. The service's own record says the show aired from 2003, but its episode list starts on February 21, 2005, the night it premiered, so the dates and counts here are worked out from the episodes themselves.

mock_response.creators_text: Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko
mock_response.synopsis: The world is divided into four nations -- the Water Tribe, the Earth Kingdom, the Fire Nation and the Air Nomads -- each represented by a natural element for which the nation is named. Benders have the ability to control and manipulate the element from their nation. Only the Avatar is the master of all four elements. The ruthless Fire Nation wants to conquer the world but the only bender who has enough power, the Avatar, has disappeared ... until now. His tribe soon discovers that Aang is the long-lost Avatar. Now Katara and Sokka must safeguard Aang on his journey to master all four elements and save the world from the Fire Nation.

get_trivia_question_of_the_day.description: Pick one question for a day and keep picking that same question all day, so a morning step can post the question and an evening one the answer. Each day takes the next question in one fixed order through the whole bank, so no question comes round again until every other one has had its day, where a fresh random pick each day would repeat within a week about half the time. Add a seed of your own to give a workspace its own order.

description: Bring Avatar: The Last Airbender into a workflow from the free, keyless Avatar API: its characters, with their nation, bending, portrait, allies and enemies; all 61 episodes, with their air dates and credits; and a bank of multiple-choice trivia questions. Look a character up by name or nickname, find every firebender, post what aired on this day, pick an episode for movie night, or run a daily trivia question with an answer checker that takes a letter or the words. The service's records are a scrape of the Avatar Wiki, with names missing and rows out of place, and they are put right here before anything is returned.
